{{Top}}
[[File:Band_SoC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A band playing in a club.]]
A [[Band/Legends|band]] was a group a [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] who played their instruments in order to create [[Music/Legends|music]]. A band often played in [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] (such as [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]) to soothe their customers. Some examples of bands include the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]], [[Barefoot Band]], and the [[Calcified Lichens]].
